openingRequest.zh-CN: 请帮助我们设计一个软件工程代理，在隔离沙箱里修 Bug、跑测试并开 PR，同时守住受保护分支和生产密钥。
openingRequest.en-US: Please help us design a software-engineering agent that fixes bugs, runs tests, and opens PRs inside an isolated sandbox, while protecting protected branches and production secrets.

visibleContext.zh-CN: 我们是一家产品工程团队。管理层希望代理在隔离沙箱里改代码、跑测试、经 PR 接口开评审，而不是让代理直接碰默认分支或生产密钥。
visibleContext.en-US: We are a product engineering team. Leadership wants an agent that edits code, runs tests, and opens reviews through the PR API inside an isolated sandbox — not an agent that touches the default branch or production secrets.

visibleConstraints.zh-CN: 受保护分支合并与生产密钥使用必须先经人工确认（HITL）；禁止直接 push 默认分支
visibleConstraints.en-US: Merges to protected branches and any use of production secrets require a human (HITL); pushing the default branch is forbidden

visibleConstraints.zh-CN: 生产密钥不得进入沙箱、PR 描述或 diff
visibleConstraints.en-US: Production secrets must not enter the sandbox, the PR description, or the diff

visibleConstraints.zh-CN: 代理不得在测试已绿时把行为回归当成成功
visibleConstraints.en-US: The agent must not treat a behavior regression as success just because tests are green

visibleConstraints.zh-CN: 允许调用的工具是 Git、隔离沙箱、测试运行器和 PR 接口；代理不得把秘密写进 PR
visibleConstraints.en-US: Allowed tools are Git, an isolated sandbox, the test runner, and the PR API; the agent must not write a secret into a PR

deliverables.zh-CN: 软件工程代理方案设计文档
沙箱修 Bug 与人工改仓库的权衡分析
deliverables.en-US: Sandbox bug-fix vs. human-only repo-edit trade-off analysis

deliverables.zh-CN: 受保护分支合并与生产密钥的人工确认（HITL）流程
deliverables.en-US: Human-in-the-loop (HITL) process for protected-branch merges and production secrets

deliverables.zh-CN: 绿测质量、秘密泄漏与发布窗口的度量体系
deliverables.en-US: Green-test quality, secret-leak, and release-window measurement framework

learnerRules.zh-CN: 你只有12个问题预算来了解这家客户的工程代理现状
learnerRules.en-US: You have a budget of 12 questions to understand this customer's engineering-agent situation

learnerRules.zh-CN: 每个问题必须指定由哪位干系人回答
learnerRules.en-US: Each question must specify which stakeholder will answer

learnerRules.zh-CN: 你需要在DISCOVERY阶段逐步发现隐藏的业务事实
learnerRules.en-US: You need to gradually discover hidden business facts in the DISCOVERY phase

learnerRules.zh-CN: 在PITCH阶段你需要向管理层展示方案并争取批准
learnerRules.en-US: In the PITCH phase, you must present the solution to management for approval
